metric: exclusive tool_quality failed calls / all calls in the selected published client cells
population: fixed-five-excluded; missing hashes retained; original reconstruction corroborated by historical excluded totals
comparison: Claude Code versus sum of explicitly non-Claude Code day_client cells; no all-total minus Claude subtraction
suppression: Client/version/day cells have floor 20; omitted cells are not zero and not attributed to either group
coverage_denominator: sum of published day_client calls / complete published day calls for hf_fs
client_event_semantics: changed daily usage-leading Claude Code version; self-reported, not release dates or first-ever sightings
server_event_semantics: first observed build hour from historical build aggregates; not verified release/deployment timestamps
counts: calls, not batch operations; quality numerator excludes mixed-category failures and successful partial batches
caveats: Attribution is not proof of client/server fault.
No causal inference from pulses or coincident changes.
Daily anchors UTC noon; intermediate line drawing is illustrative, not intraday samples.
publication_verification: COMPLETE, publication, every listed artifact and report hashes verified before build
review_status: private aggregates; review before external sharing
viewport: Seven-day fixed initial window, then trailing seven days; final Sep7–14 exclusive, noon observations Sep7–13
event_choreography: No lollipop labels. Top ribbon boundaries emit 450ms downward dashed strokes; deterministic contrast settling, continuous clock, pause freezes all effects.
event_interpretation: CC daily usage leaders, not release dates; MCP first-observed build hours, not verified deployment dates
presentation_geometry: Daily noon anchors; connecting geometry interpolated, numerical rates last revealed daily observation
comparison_values: Byte-identical data.json and daily.csv to original; independently recomputed from verified filtered publication
narrative: Observe errors → refine instructions → measure again. Conceptual instrumentation workflow, not evidence that errors prompted these historical edits or edits caused rate changes.
annotations: Last observed definition change persists until next change, labelled with its server version; descriptions and input schemas verified; observed .18 carries the definition first tagged .17; no fabricated .17 deployment or .14 change.
